comments: Per-model translation settings for scripts/translate.py, looked up by full model name, then the name without its tag, then "default"; a model entry overrides default keys (options merge key by key). prompt: "instruct" (system prompt, earlier chunks as chat turns) or "translategemma" (its fixed published format). chunk_chars: largest request, in source characters. batch: pack consecutive paragraphs into one request as <segN> tags. context_chars: source characters of preceding chunks replayed with their translations. glossary: extract recurring names and dictionary-unknown words once per book, translate them, and give each request the entries it contains (saved as <output>.glossary.json; edit and rerun to correct). think: Ollama thinking level or false. retry_temperature: sampling for the one retry after a markup failure. qwen3.8:latest was chosen on 2026-10-06 from a grid over 21 paragraphs of The Cosmic Serpent; see docs/research.md, 'Translation settings'.
